title: "Wonkette as Hayekian"
date: "2006-01-12"
categories: ["Culture & Society"]
---

[P J O’Rourke](http://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2006/01/05/AR2006010501670.html "P J O’Rourke") on Ana Marie Cox’s [Dog Days](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/1594489017/ref=ase_institutional-20/103-3650639-0974267?s=books&v=glance&n=283155&tagActionCode=institutional-20 "Dog Days"):

*Dog Days is comparable to Friedrich Hayek’s [The Road to Serfdom](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/0226320618/ref=ase_institutional-20/103-3650639-0974267?s=books&v=glance&n=283155&tagActionCode=institutional-20 "The Road to Serfdom"). Albeit the prose makes Hayek’s seem elegant and pellucid. But Hayek’s first language was German. Cox’s first language is blog.*

Ouch!
